positions.as_written: Assess the effusion and the range, since stiffness after this operation is a recognised problem.
Assess the patellar translation laterally, comparing it with the other side and with the preoperative record.
Assess the medial translation, because a patella that will not move medially has been tethered.
Assess the patellar tilt, since an over tightened reconstruction tilts the patella medially.
